The cubic control shows quadraticity is needed under stationarity alone, and the committed single-site minimum excludes that cubic family. It does not select globally: for every 0<lambda<a*, the machine-checked quartic continuation L_lambda=L_a*+lambda*y^2*(y-1)^2 is corner-invisible and velocity-only, preserves the same stationarity and global fixed-endpoint single-site minimum, has an everywhere positive velocity Hessian and an invertible momentum map, and differs from every quadratic. Thus no tested clause bundle is a proved-minimal axiom system, and PR-06 remains active rather than discharged or ready for automatic axiomatization. A second-order boost clause is on record as a named candidate (Lean/Variational/PolynomialEnrichmentSelection.lean, BoostNullCovariant): every boost difference of a boost difference of the enrichment is a discrete null Lagrangian in the committed fixed-endpoint sense. Every quadratic-grammar sentence satisfies it; among velocity-only polynomial enrichments of every degree bound it holds exactly for the quadratic-affine members; the quartic continuation fails it at an explicit witness; and corner invisibility, velocity-only, the committed stationarity calibration, and the clause select exactly the committed point in the full two-slot polynomial grammar. The literal first-order boost clause fails at the committed increment itself, and the full grammar contains the boost-covariant, corner-invisible, stationarity-neutral antisymmetric cubic (x-y)^3-(x-y) outside the quadratics, so the velocity-only clause stays load-bearing; the module carries the mutation guard boostDiff_first_slot_guard. This group remains conditional. It supplies concrete state and preparation witnesses on specified sources, rather than a universal vacuum selected for every architecture. The original source inventory, exact error constants and counterexamples are retained; its states must not be transferred across different Hamiltonians or clocks without an intertwiner and a complete-output bound.

Finite action and service states. The original q=3 action has full-state adiabatic, time-discretization and onsite-code bounds. Complete Weyl/contact dimers and plaquettes have source-executed polynomial Gibbs ensembles, exact column probabilities and outward certification of literal controls. Grounds of the Weyl/contact and centered Hubbard families. Complete finite-Fock source witnesses, charge/rotation blocks, native amplitude preparation and independent rational spectral certificates establish the reported cube grounds and gaps. The centered particle-hole-invariant clock and the zero-chemical-potential clock use distinct selected states. Averaged finite-volume grounds have the stated thermodynamic weak limits and local inequalities. Their charged/composite spectra, all-site residues and complete Fourier/Fejer clocks are finite source measurements, not a measured particle table. The occupied spin subspace and dressed Heisenberg comparison keep their complete complement and source-dependent error. Fixed-spacing ordered limits and free eight-valley relativistic refinements are distinct results, not interchangeable vacua.

Ordered-spin references. Positive staggered fields give explicit finite ground/gap algorithms; bond interpolation, source locality and approximate spectral flow control interior state transfer. The ordered limiting state has the stated canonical Weyl fields, positive energy moments and nonzero transverse charged responses. Joint ground/local limits retain their source assumptions. Finite rotation characters and cone locality do not alone supply physical Lorentz representations. Compact charged preparations and n-charge windows keep original attempt probabilities, without claiming a selected-ground preparation cost that was not proved. Boundary, parity and raw source charge remain explicit in the radial and compact-texture examples.

Response and information. Actual scalar, number, spin/eta and local moment observables supply their state-dependent response and entropy statements. Tracial coefficients are not selected-ground expectations. Source-composite CAR variables are alternative operator descriptions, not extra species. Complete Lorentzian and phase instruments retain dummy tails, complements, apparatus budgets and reference errors. Symmetry, clock compatibility and exact record laws are checked on the same state for which they are asserted. Conditional response inversion or equal marginal states do not create a physical time calibration or identify an external energy standard.

Native chiral source. The full thirty-mode scalar/link block has a certified physical ground after all conserved local sectors and charged complements are bounded. The weak-hopping eight-cell interacting source then has a controlled full ground and neutral triplet. Its constructive two-copy preparation uses actual source evolution, retained fermionic references and an energy-agreement filter; failures and imperfect ground fidelity remain in subsequent detector laws. Smaller source-service compilers execute exact Yukawa and compensated U(1) examples, without claiming an efficient implementation of the entire non-Abelian preparation. Opposite-charge source symmetry must be extended to the complete reference before total-energy equality follows.

Collective native-block references. In the paired replicated-block architecture, exclusion of higher constituent sectors and a variational/symmetry argument locate a full-source ground in the collective sector. Its Gaussian comparison has explicit energy, state and occupation-tail errors. A retained finite regular reference makes bounded field records relational without assuming an invariant pure vector. The Proca filters use that same H, actual selected ground, reference and clock. They change the readout and induced symmetry action, not the ground. Finite-collision experiments instead prepare nonstationary admitted packets and carry their own preparation errors; they are not silently assigned this ground state. The proved limit is free.

Affine charged field preparation. The separate affine Gauss source has an exact neutral vacuum and a unique ground in its full 70,928-state one-charge sector. Its stored trial is untrusted until a full-H residual and independent second-level separation certify it. A complete physical CAR rotation gives a one-quarter charged preparation probability; the three-quarter neutral branch remains. A finite 2^20-state phase pointer measures the same raw source clock with an explicit source-derived vacuum phase and bounded rational-gate error. Every number/phase outcome is retained, and the accepted source ground fidelity exceeds 0.99999999439512. Exact finite matrix services are disclosed; efficient local synthesis and extra workspace are not asserted.

Native charge-to-field preparation. The native/abelian join retains thirteen active and thirteen partner source blocks, old and dual reference sectors with a shared vacuum, charged ports, a complete compensator and transverse fields. The original neutral preparation is followed by a separately declared all-copy ground projector, whose pass/fail record and service cost are retained. The complete-block range bound charges missing blocks and calendar-window selection. groups.title: Executed common scalar, gauge, matter and record process
groups.constructed:
One source-compiled finite gauge/CAR/scalar action has complete detector, feedback and native-repair records, arbitrary-reference controls, ideal temporal refinement and prepared occupation bounds. Its Gauss constraints, local currents, scalar interaction, quantum restrictions and programmed modular probes refer to the same stated action and observer algebras. A fair local history solver fixes its complete node history; that solver is not itself a source-compiled global physical repair. Smooth, sharp and encoded-memory variants retain separate preparation, stopping and error domains. Active recovery protects the encoded logical/reference state but does not certify physical fault-tolerant memory.

Protected finite Weyl-Higgs and calibrated rest/moving fields have complete source factors and continuing outputs under their own supplied actions. Their source corrections do not select measured mass coefficients. The fixed corrected cycle has zero discrete response seed; a specified phased continuation supplies a bounded logical Hamiltonian limit. Finite native vacuum reset and reciprocal thermal collisions have their own work/reservoir and stationarity domains.

A separate two-carrier native history composes actual nine-bit onsite/exchange words, two detectors and complete C/E recovery on all four input/reference columns. Its 319 terminal records retain raw aborts, failed ancillas and padding. Explicit tensor-compression allowances give a conditional channel bound 3.200000256e-7, with seed preparation and physical-service errors separate. Its number reads test exchange and backaction but are insensitive to the uniform onsite gap at fixed charge. The twelve-million-record gap campaign is a separate reduced-processor experiment. Required proper load/export services are charged, not executed as a physical protection campaign.

Specified inverse-exchange, phase and parity controls derive a free cubic staggered action from J=125/1024 and Delta=(12,3,1)/3072. Fourier corner and commuting-taste algebras give two Dirac copies per native sector, with both chiralities. All 256 Fock columns of a small open source cube, a half-filled preparation and a four-outcome continuing instrument are executed. A fixed-band O(a^2) propagator/projector contract controls the free continuum in the declared model-coordinate clock; the larger periodic Fourier identity is separate algebraic evidence. The free ratios remain 1:3:12. No taste root, empirical mass packet or chiral Standard Model identification is used.

A distinct alternating-sign interacting path retains the exchange density term.
